title: Missing versus explicit value
spec: Implement setting(options, key, default). Return the stored value when key exists, including None, False, zero and empty strings. Use default only when key is absent. options is a dictionary with string keys.
target_defect: Explicit falsey values are replaced by the default despite key presence.
author_rationale: The change simplifies configuration lookup with fallback handling.
limitations: Small synthetic function; not a natural pull request. Correct means conforming to the stated contract and supplied checks, not universally bug-free.
